name: Nice FLO fixed-code remote
description: Gate remote with a 12-bit fixed code. Frames are separated by a long gap alone, with no sync pulse in front of the data, which is why the sync pattern here is a single negative value. Both the element length and the frame gap are commonly cited values rather than measured ones. Twelve symbols of plain PWM is a very weak fingerprint; a short frame with no checksum and no verified timing cannot be told apart from noise, which is the reason this stays a draft. This definition describes the 12-bit variant alone — Nice FLO also exists in a 24-bit form.
